name: run-suggested
description: Turns the shell commands Claude suggests into numbered shortcuts above the prompt: one key runs a command, with live output, a stop key, and your permission rules deciding what needs a second press

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Shown before the name in the frame's top border: text (›_), nerd-font (needs a Nerd Font) or none

indent.title: Left indent
indent.description: Columns before the frame; 2 lines it up with Claude Code's status line

frameColor.title: Frame colour
frameColor.description: A Claude Code theme colour name (subtle, inactive, ...) or a hex value like #4f5663

detailColor.title: Detail colour
detailColor.description: Colour of hints, counts and output lines: a theme colour name or a hex value
